subject: different dispersal multipliers between the same and adjacent areas?

messages.author: ae45762450a9203e
messages.subject: different dispersal multipliers between the same and adjacent areas?
parts: Dear Nick, please, in my manual dispersal multiplier matrix, I'm thinking about to attribute slightly different dispersal multipliers between the same area, when comparing this area to another adjacent one; e.g. A to A = 1; and A to B = 0.9. Do you think it makes sense?

messages.author: 115d05260b0c341a
messages.subject: Re: [BioGeoBEARS] different dispersal multipliers between the same and adjacent areas?
parts:
Hi -- A to A isn't dispersal, so what you put there doesn't really matter.  I put "1" just for convention, but the only thing that BioGeoBEARS makes use of is the off-diagonal numbers.

Cheers!
Nick
